known_issues: Admin area hangs indefinitely (infinite loading) in production despite successful Internet Identity login

existing_features.title: Fix the Admin Dashboard page so it no longer hangs indefinitely after a successful Internet Identity login. The page currently shows an infinite loading state instead of rendering the admin tabs. Investigate and resolve the race condition or timeout issue in the admin authentication check (useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout) that causes the page to never transition out of the loading state in production.

Ensure the backend actor used in the Admin Dashboard is created with the authenticated identity (not anonymous) when the user is logged in via Internet Identity. If the actor is being instantiated before the identity is fully available, add proper sequencing so the admin check only fires once an authenticated actor is ready.

projectName: Fix Admin Dashboard infinite loading after Internet Identity login
